crossRefs.note: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with…
